attributes.board_name: Idaho Speech, Hearing and Communication Services Licensure Board (DOPL)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE directly related to the scope of practice, sponsored by a national, state or regional professional association or an institution of higher education. 1 contact hour = 1 clock hour of participation (meals and breaks excluded). Board-approved college courses: 1 semester credit = 15 contact hours, 1 quarter credit = 10. Proctoring the Board's hearing aid exam: 3 h per exam, max 6 h per year and 9 h per 3 years.
rules.audit_note: Licensees keep documentation of attendance; subject to audit and must be provided on request.
rules.notes: The rule requires 10 contact hours in the 12 months preceding each renewal. From Aug 1, 2026 DOPL is moving this board to 2-year licenses expiring on the licensee's birthday (2026 renewals: even birth year expires 2028, odd birth year 2027); DOPL states CE requirements do not change, so the hours must still fall in the 12 months before renewal. The rule applies to each licensee (audiologists, SLPs and licensed SLP assistants).
